text:
riley: Heads-up: Support logged request from GlobalShop (Dedicated) asking us to forward streaming chat + tool calls to their webhook with partial structured frames so their storefront can render incremental results. Ticket: https://globalshop.example/t/299

sam: Are they blocked? timeline?

riley: Blocked for a new checkout feature. Need first partial within ~200ms and tool outputs as separate JSON frames. They want an opt-in flag on their project.

maya: engineering read: minimal approach is to emit NDJSON frames with a small envelope: {"frame":"tool","id":"f_123","seq":2,"cursor":"c_9","data":{...}}. Cursor is a short token we can GC. No immediate full server-side resume for MVP.

frank: product acceptance (pilot): opt-in Dedicated flag, frames with seq+cursor, resume TTL 30s, at-least-once delivery + SDK dedupe guidance, basic telemetry. GA needs server-side rehydrate, SDKs, and latency SLA.

sam: risks?

maya: stateful cursor store cost + GC; webhook retries can cause duplicate side-effects so we must require idempotent tool adapters or provide a replay-safe wrapper. Also security review if frames contain PII.

zane: rough effort: MVP emitter + forwarder + short cursor store = 2 engs for 3 weeks. Full resume = several sprints.

riley: proposal: create a P2 backlog card for a customer pilot. owner: maya (eng), sam (PM). Deliverables: RFC, NDJSON samples, pilot test plan, telemetry dashboard, rollback toggle.

maya: Ill draft RFC with examples by next Wed. I'll include a sample NDJSON line and an example client reassembly snippet.

ci-bot: created PROD-1622 "dedicated-webhook-partial-frames-pilot (GlobalShop)" assigned to maya, labels: customer-pilot,p2,webhook-streaming

sam: noted. action items: maya to RFC, sam to write pilot success metrics, zane to scope infra spike. Add any legal/SRE notes on the RFC thread. :thumbsup:
